title: Per-diem microbudget and QR vendor map
content:
Notes to self: quick cheat-sheet for roadshows and conferences — focus on minimal receipts, fast reimbursements, and vendor QR flows. Keep this as a light pocket doc to copy into calendar invites or share with contractors.

Top priorities:
- Make sure corporate card used where possible (hotel, flights). Personal card only for taxis/food if needed and small.
- Use Expensify mobile app to scan receipts immediately — tag with project code before leaving venue.
- For vendors with QR codes: scan QR -> pay -> screenshot receipt -> flag vendor name + amount in the app. Many small vendors won't give printed receipts.
- Keep per-diem notes by city to avoid over-submitting. If conference provides meals, don't claim those meals separately.

Per-diem microbudget (recommended quick rules):
- SFO / Bay Area: $75/day for meals + incidentals (conference days)
- NYC: $85/day
- London: £60/day (approx $75)
- Berlin: €55/day
- Remote or small towns: $50/day
- If host covers dinner or event meal: reduce day by 40% (mark in notes)

Common expense categories and short labels to use in expense app (helps accounting):
- TRAVEL_FLT (airfare)
- TRAVEL_RAIL
- ACCOM_HOTEL
- MEALS_PERDIEM
- MEALS_EXTERNAL (client meal)
- LOCAL_TRANS (taxi/ride-share)
- SUPPLIES (shipping, adapters)
- EVENT_FEES (booth, sponsorship)

Quick-submit flow (if you want reimbursement within 7 business days):
1) Take photo + upload receipt to Expensify, tag project code and label category.
2) Add short note: "event: <name>, date, host contact".
3) If paid in cash/QR, include screenshot of confirmation, vendor name, and the approximate tax ID if available.
4) Submit expense and ping #travel-ops in Slack with the expense link and "urgent" label.

Conference logistics checklist (pre-trip):
- Confirm hotel booking with company card (booking ref and corporate rate)
- Add event badge pickup window to calendar and set reminder 1 hour before
- Pack receipts envelope (physical) and new phone charger bank (for scanning receipts)
- Preload Expensify and 2FA on phone 
- Note local petty-cash vendors (food trucks, coffee stands) — use QR map below
- Share emergency contact (on-call ops + onsite host) with travel buddy

Onsite vendor QR map (my short list to hand to vendor-facing folks):
- Coffee: BrewBooth (QR: brewbooth.io/pay) — typical $4-8, screenshot receipt
- Shipping (booth materials): QuickShip SF (qr: quickship.app/sf) — usually invoices, confirm VAT/GST line
- Booth support / AV: StudioAV — contact Jordan (studioav@local) / phone +1-415-555-0186
- Local printer (last-minute handouts): PrintPop — QR pays, ask for "business receipt"
- Taxi alternative: RideShareX promo code for events; keep screenshot of ride summary

Vendor contact quicknotes (copy into Slack DM to ops if needed):
- Hotel: Grand Harbor — frontdesk@grandharbor.com / +1-415-555-0101 (use booking ref on corporate card)
- Freight/Logistics: QuickShip SF — logistics@quickship.app / +1-415-555-0112 (book with PO if > $500)
- AV: Jordan / StudioAV — jordan@studioav.io / +1-415-555-0186
- Catering lead (onsite): Maria G. — maria@eventcater.co / +44 20 7 555 0133 (ask for itemized invoice)

Accounting gotchas (things I forgot last time):
- If vendor invoices include VAT, mark VAT amount in the expense note or attach invoice PDF; accounting needs VAT separate field.
- Per-diem vs actual meals: choose one per day in policy. Don't double-claim.
- Tips: small local tips under $10 typically classed as incidentals — attach note.

Open questions / TODOs:
- Confirm whether corporate card can be used for small local vendors that only accept local mobile wallets (we got blocked last month).
- Need a quick printable "receipt cover sheet" template for contractors to staple when vendor gives a handwritten note. (Draft one?)
- Check if QuickShip can send a pro-forma invoice before pickup to avoid PO delays.

Repeating checklist to paste into calendar invite for attendees: (short)
- Hotel booking ref + check-in instructions
- Badge pickup time/location
- Per-diem amount and policy link
- Expensify upload instructions + tag to use
- Emergency on-call: ops@redwood.com / +1-650-555-0123

Notes to self - style + copy bits:
- Keep tone short and imperative for event handouts.
- Use the short label codes for accounting to reduce back-and-forth.
- When in doubt, capture a screenshot of the payment confirmation even if vendor can't provide a receipt — include vendor name and timestamp.

Random scribbles (leftover):
- Bring USB-C multi-adapter and ethernet dongle for booth laptop (always forget)
- Buy $20 preloaded vendor card for small cash-only items? maybe not worth it

If I end up polishing this, split into two artifacts: 1) "one-pager to hand attendees" and 2) "ops checklist for shipping & vendors". For now this is the pocket version.

— Ravi
